user.title: Connect your WiiM
user.description: Enter your WiiM's local IP or hostname. Certificate verification is enabled by default. If your device uses a self-signed certificate, you may disable verification for this device on your trusted LAN.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address, network access, and HTTPS certificate setting.
error.invalid_host: Enter only an IP address or hostname, without a URL or port.

abort.already_configured: This WiiM is already configured; its connection settings have been updated.
